statusLanguageNote: Retained verbatim as required. This audit classifies governing-layer ownership; it does not itself promote the governed resolution status, which requires independent QA.
objective: Classify unresolved Road LTL references by governing layer before selecting any repair.

priorClaimCorrected.priorStatement: R0.1B audit reported 0/23 canonical references resolve against the Universe.
priorClaimCorrected.correction: Accurate but measured against one layer only. Neither identifier class is owned by the Universe layer, so non-resolution there is expected rather than defective. Both classes resolve within their own governing layer.
priorClaimCorrected.governingRuleApplied: FINDING-UNIVERSE-02: unresolved references must not be presumed missing Universe identifiers until ownership is determined.

evidence: Zero objects anywhere in governed custody define an a5-* identifier; it appears exclusively as the value of the field a5ContractId.

All 82 of 82 warehouse lineage rows satisfy a5-{moduleSuffix}-{processSuffix} derived from the daughter module id and its own process id, so the identifier carries no information beyond the daughter's own module and process identity.
Not present in the governed Universe semantic payload at semantic structures SHA-256 82104521...
The identifier space spans daughter modules only: {'road-ltl': 22, 'ocean-fcl': 30, 'ocean-lcl': 30}.
A_a5_ownership.determination: a5-* is a Daughter-local derived contract identifier owned by the daughter module layer. It is NOT a Universe canonical identifier and its absence from the Universe is not a reference defect.

evidence: All 22 referenced scp-* identifiers are defined in data/crosswalks/process-concept-crosswalk-v1.json under concepts[].conceptId. Orphans: 0.
Every concept carries definitionStatus ATLAS_CANONICAL_CROSS_MODULE_CONCEPT, which places ownership in an Atlas cross-module concept layer rather than in the Universe.
Each concept records sourceModuleSeed and sourceProcessId, showing the concept was seeded from a daughter process and then generalized across modules.
All 11 distinct enterpriseTerritory values resolve to Universe domain ids, so the concept layer is anchored to the Universe without being defined inside it.
All 22 mappings are mappingType SPECIALIZES with status APPROVED_BASELINE.
B_scp_ownership.determination: scp-* is a governed cross-layer contract identifier owned by the Atlas cross-module process-concept layer, anchored to Universe domains via enterpriseTerritory. It is NOT a Universe canonical identifier and is fully resolved within its own layer.

C_layerModel.note: Derived from evidence, not invented. Each layer is named only where governed artifacts demonstrate it.

layers.owns: domains, business objects, systems, documents, exchanges and related ontology
module process ids (LTL-01..22) and derived a5-* contract ids

openCoverageGaps.statement: The cross-module concept layer covers only road-ltl (22 mappings) while the a5-* identifier space spans {'road-ltl': 22, 'ocean-fcl': 30, 'ocean-lcl': 30}. Ocean FCL and Ocean LCL modules declare no processConceptMappings and reference no scp-* concept.
openCoverageGaps.reason: No Ocean reference is broken; Ocean simply has no concept mapping yet. The crosswalk anticipates this with its own rule futureModuleMappingsRequiredForA5Compare=true.

E_recommendedRepairTypeNoMutation.note: Recommendations only. This stage performed no mutation and created no identifier or mapping.

recommendations.action: Record that both identifier classes are correctly owned outside the Universe layer and that no reference repair is required. Governed resolution status should move from UNCLASSIFIED_PENDING_REFERENCE_OWNERSHIP_AUDIT to a classified state only by independent QA.

Register the cross-module concept layer as a governed asset with repositoryPath and sha256 so later stages resolve scp-* ownership without rediscovery. It is currently unregistered in ASSET_REGISTER.json.
Extend concept mappings to Ocean modules during R0.5, using the crosswalk's own SPECIALIZES/APPROVED_BASELINE convention. Not an R0.1C action and not a reference repair.
Record that Universe non-resolution of a5-*/scp-* is expected by design, so future audits do not re-raise it as a defect.

outOfScopeConfirmations: No crosswalk invented; the existing governed crosswalk was consumed as evidence.

auditScope.rationale: The audit inventories references carried by governed source/model evidence. Audit and governance records that quote identifiers as findings are excluded so the audit cannot read its own output; counts are unaffected by the exclusion.
